RE1MV PartList Animation Fix
============================

Main issue fixed:
  EDD/EMR pose data was correct, but the standalone viewer assembled EM1111 with
  the old hardcoded RE1MV Build_Model stack.  That could split torso/legs/arms.

New behavior:
  The viewer now reads the EMR PartListOffset child table and uses it as the
  skeleton hierarchy by default.  The legacy stack remains available only via
  --legacy-buildmodel / --legacy-stack.

Validation against supplied RE1MV ANI exports:
  EM1111_00_idle.ANI -> tree_match=True, frames 31/31, max_abs_delta=0.000495, OK
  EM1111.ANI         -> tree_match=True, frames 645/645, max_abs_delta=0.000495, OK

EM1111 Bank B clip counts:
  clips: 31 entries, indexed 0..30
  clip00: 31 frames, poses 0..30
  clip01: 31 frames, poses 31..61
  clip02: 10 frames, poses 62..71
  clip03: 42 frames, poses 72..113
  clip04: 20 frames, poses 114..133
  clip05: 20 frames, poses 134..153

Build:
  make clean && make -> OK
  tests/smoke.sh -> OK

See docs/deep_anim_v11/RE1MV_PARTLIST_ANIM_FIX.md for details.
